title: In-silico screening and molecular dynamics simulation of quinazolinone derivatives as PARP1 and STAT3 dual inhibitors: a novel DML approaches.
authors: Dilipkumar, S; Karthik, V; Dk, Shanmuganathan; Gowramma, Byran; Lakshmanan, Kaviarasan
one_liner_zh: 该文用DML方法筛选喹唑啉酮衍生物作为PARP1和STAT3双靶点抑制剂，核心是蛋白-小分子药物设计，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，仅含分子对接和MD模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Modern cancer therapy now routinely employs the blocking of many oncoproteins or pathways. With two or more medicines, multiple inhibitions are often accomplished via DML techniques. In this study, we developed 30 quinazolinone derivatives as PARP1 and STAT3 dual inhibitors using DML methods and these compounds were tested for their dual inhibitory effect on PARP1 and STAT3 using docking, MM-GBSA, and molecular dynamics simulation investigations. The docking studies of ligands against PARP1 and STAT3 were performed using the Glide module, in silico ADMET screening was performed using the quickprob module, binding energy calculation was performed using the Prime MM-GBSA module, MD simulation was performed using the Desmond module, and atomic charges were calculated using the Jaguar module of Schrodinger suite 2019-4. Of the substances studied, the derivative 1f has a considerable gliding score. The in silico ADMET characteristics are within the approved range. PRIME MM-GB/SA was used to compute the binding free energy, and the results are substantial. To investigate the dynamic behavior of the protein-ligand complex, compound 1f was subjected to MD simulation at 100 ns. The tested chemical 1f produced the greatest results in MD simulations and MM-GBSA calculations, indicating that this ligand can inhibit more effectively.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 现代癌症治疗现已常规采用阻断多种癌蛋白或信号通路的方法。通过两种或更多药物，常借助DML技术实现多重抑制。在本研究中，我们利用DML方法开发了30种喹唑啉酮衍生物作为PARP1和STAT3双重抑制剂，并通过对接、MM-GBSA及分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟研究测试了这些化合物对PARP1和STAT3的双重抑制效果。配体对PARP1和STAT3的对接研究使用Glide模块进行，计算机模拟ADMET筛选使用quickprob模块，结合能计算使用Prime MM-GBSA模块，MD模拟使用Desmond模块，原子电荷计算使用Schrodinger套件2019-4中的Jaguar模块。在所研究的物质中，衍生物1f具有显著的滑行得分。计算机模拟ADMET特性均在批准范围内。使用PRIME MM-GB/SA计算结合自由能，结果显著。为研究蛋白质-配体复合物的动态行为，对化合物1f进行了100 ns的MD模拟。测试化合物1f在MD模拟和MM-GBSA计算中产生了最佳结果，表明该配体可更有效地抑制。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
